headline: CPI 3.7%, core 2.6%, Kospi -9%, Nasdaq futures -1.3%, 10y 5.11% overnight, Brent $104.30
stance: Hot CPI met an AI-funding scare. Chips led Asia down 4-8% overnight; PPI at 8:30am is the next test for October hike odds.

news.head: TSMC beats, raises 2026 growth to ~44%
news.body: Q3 revenue $46.7bn vs $45.6bn est, +41% y/y. Q4 guide $52.3-54.3bn. ADR -1.7% after hours (~3am ET).

news.head: CoreWeave -15% Wednesday, 2032 bonds above 15%
news.body: About $50bn owed to creditors. Stock -4.5% pre-market (~4am ET). Oracle -9% Wednesday, -2% pre-market.

news.head: Morgan Stanley equities +41%, stock -2.8%
news.body: Equities revenue $5.8bn, $900m above estimates. Fixed income -7%. EPS $3.03 vs $2.91 est.

news.head: SK Hynix -11%, Samsung -9% in Seoul (~11pm ET)
news.body: Memory names led the Asian chip rout. The index is now more than 40% off its June record.

implications: Core at 0.3% with gasoline +9.1% puts October live again. A hot PPI at 8:30am pushes October hike odds back toward Wednesday's 54% high.
The chip bellwether beat and raised; the stock still fell. Funding cost, not demand, now prices AI capex. Watch triple-C spreads and the 10y through earnings.

watch.head: PPI, retail sales, claims, 8:30am
watch.body: Core PPI is the number. Pass-through from energy to core goods is what the Fed is watching.

watch.head: Schwab, US Bancorp, PNC report today
watch.body: Net interest income and deposit costs after the big banks' flat-to-down fixed income.

watch.head: EIA crude inventories today
watch.body: API showed an 11.1m-barrel draw for the week to Oct 9. Confirmed, it is the largest since June 2025.

watch.head: FOMC, Oct 28
watch.body: Hike odds 27% (~4am ET), 54% at Wednesday's peak. December hike 67%. Daly: more hikes likely, not October.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Core CPI 0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y Wednesday, both above consensus. Gasoline +9.1% m/m took headline to 3.7%, from 3.4%.
10y 5.105%, -8bp in Asian trade (~3am ET) on a haven bid out of equities. 2y 4.73%, -7bp.
Brent $104.30, -1.7% (~2:30am ET). Shadow-fleet sanctions relief talk outweighed two ships sunk in Hormuz Wednesday.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 6: Mexican peso specs extended short at the 3rd percentile, new this week, down 16 points.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: S&P -1.11%, Nasdaq -1.88% Wednesday, biggest drops since July. SOX -4.3%, seventh straight loss.
Kospi -9.1% (~2:30am ET) after a 20-minute halt, 6-month low. Nikkei -4.9%, worst day since March. Taiex -3.4%.
Futures (~4am ET): Nasdaq 100 -1.26%, S&P -0.35%, Dow +0.39%. Selling is in AI leaders, not the broad index.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 6: Nasdaq 100 specs extended long at the 100th percentile, third week. Standing background into a 1.9% down day.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Triple-C OAS 1,267bp Tuesday, from 904bp in early May. Higher-rated HY moved far less: stress sits in the bottom tier.
IG spread share of total yield below 15% vs a 45% historical mean. Spreads and Treasury yields now rise together.
Largest data-center issuer: 5y default protection near 881bp Monday, from 547bp end-June. AI issuers over 6% of IG market cap, nearly 8% of duration.
sections.positioning: Primary dealers' HY inventory at the 99th percentile of 3 years, second week. Less room to absorb client selling if triple-C keeps widening.
